id./param/scenario/cs/b_110_cs_070.pack|cs_: "Hey, lads, put your backs into it! Lord Gyldygga is waiting!
"These monsters mean to carry off the people turned to golden statues. Could they be behind the Gold Fever too?
"Hm, what do you think you're doing? Surely you don't mean to defy our boss, Spectral Sentinel Gyldygga?
"Boss or Sentinel, I won't overlook your outrages against this town!
"Hmph! Humans who aren't gold aren't worth taking...
"Whoever hinders Lord Gyldygga's loot, we won't forgive! Lads, crush them!
